<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $o,
        public ?string $arr,
        public ?string $empty,
        public string $nul,
        public ?string $str,
        public ?string $dupKeys,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            o: $data['o'],
            arr: $data['arr'],
            empty: $data['empty'],
            nul: $data['nul'],
            str: $data['str'],
            dupKeys: $data['dupKeys'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'o' => $this->o,
            'arr' => $this->arr,
            'empty' => $this->empty,
            'nul' => $this->nul,
            'str' => $this->str,
            'dupKeys' => $this->dupKeys,
        ];
    }
}
